title: Indian Visa Online application form
before: Choose the e-Tourist Visa if your passport is on the e-Visa list. Otherwise choose the regular visa application (Lebanese and Egyptian passports).
The first page has a CAPTCHA and gives you a temporary application ID: write it down to come back later.
Dates are day/month/year. The dates below are already in that order.

sections.title: Applicant details

fields.label: Citizenship/national ID number
fields.note: Write NA if your passport shows none.

yourself: Whether you changed your name or hold another passport

sections.title: Address and family
yourself: Your parents' nationality and place of birth
Whether your parents or grandparents were Pakistani nationals

sections.title: Visa details

fields.label: Expected port of exit
fields.note: Change it if you'll leave from a different airport.

fields.label: Have you ever visited India before?
Has an Indian visa ever been refused?
Countries visited in the last 10 years

yourself: SAARC countries visited in the last 3 years

sections.title: Additional questions
yourself: The yes/no security and criminal-record questions, then the declaration. Answer each one yourself.

sections.title: Uploads
yourself: Your square photo (JPEG) and the passport details page (PDF); for an e-Visa, keep each under the size the page shows

after: e-Tourist Visa: pay online, wait for the email, and check it says GRANTED before you fly. Print it and give your fingerprints on arrival.
Regular visa: print the completed form, sign it, and take it with your passport, photo and documents to the Embassy of India.
Record the decision on your dashboard.
